text:
Zoe Park: Noticing a visual clash in the console: toasts overlap the table header at narrow widths and the modal footer shadow looks heavier than our card shadows. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.example/ui/toast-header-clash.png :eyes:

Marta L.: Repro on FF. Toast is inside the list container so it creates stacking issues. Also ghost button focus on dark surfaces.
design-ci-bot: Recommendation: portal to root, use `position: fixed` with token `--toast-offset-top`, lower toast z-index to 1100, and increase ghost focus to 2px on dark surfaces. Add aria-live and explicit copy (e.g., "Settings saved" fallback "Changes saved").
Ishaan: I'll land a small PR with tokens and a visual test. Will include migration notes and storybook snapshots. ETA today. :thumbsup:
